name: Phantom Record Buster
author: Rob Holmes

sections.description: Phantom Record Buster is a lightweight tool designed to identify and remove orphaned or ‘phantom’ records from your WordPress database. It helps maintain site performance by keeping your database clean and efficient.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the settings via the Tools menu.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Initial stable release.
  • Corrected plugin header metadata for repository compatibility.
